items.headline: Wake Forest takes down No. 16 Louisville for road upset
items.description: Wake Forest's block of Louisville's field goal attempt with 15 seconds left sealed its 30-27 upset of the 16th-ranked Cardinals.

items.headline: Wake Forest scores 'ugly' upset on the road, takes down No. 16 Louisville 30-27
items.description: — Connor Calvert kicked three field goals, including a 32-yarder with 6:20 remaining, to lift Wake Forest to a 30-27 win over No. 16 Louisville on Saturday.
